title: Salmon Teriyaki Noodles
teaser: Pan-fried salmon and noodles tossed in a sticky homemade teriyaki sauce.
ingredients: Spring onion and sesame seeds to garnish
steps: Cook the noodles according to packet instructions and drain.
Season the salmon and pan-fry skin-side down for 4-5 minutes, then flip and cook for 2-3 minutes more. Flake into chunks.
Whisk the soy sauce, honey, vinegar, and garlic together in the pan and simmer for 1-2 minutes until slightly sticky.
Toss the noodles through the sauce, then fold in the salmon.
Drizzle with sesame oil and top with spring onion and sesame seeds.

title: Chicken Noodle Stir-Fry
teaser: Chicken and vegetables stir-fried with noodles in a simple soy sauce.
steps: Cook the noodles according to packet instructions, drain, and set aside.
Stir-fry the chicken in a hot wok until cooked through, then set aside.
Add the pepper and carrot and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes.
Add the garlic, then return the chicken and noodles to the pan with the soy sauce and sesame oil.
Toss everything together for 1-2 minutes and serve.

title: Sticky Sesame Chicken Noodles
teaser: Chicken and egg noodles tossed in a sticky sesame-soy glaze.
steps: Cook the noodles according to packet instructions, drain, and set aside.
Stir-fry the chicken in a little vegetable oil over high heat until cooked through and lightly browned.
Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds.
Stir in the soy sauce, honey, and sesame oil, and simmer for 1-2 minutes until sticky.
Toss the noodles through the chicken and sauce, and top with sesame seeds.

title: Spicy Peanut Chicken Noodles
teaser: Noodles and chicken tossed in a quick peanut butter and chilli sauce.
ingredients: Splash of hot water to loosen
steps: Cook the noodles according to packet instructions, drain, and set aside.
Stir-fry the chicken in a little oil until cooked through and lightly browned.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, rice vinegar, chilli flakes, and garlic together, adding hot water until pourable.
Toss the noodles and sauce through the chicken in the pan.
Serve immediately, with extra chilli flakes if you like it hotter.

title: Garlic Butter Shrimp Noodles
teaser: Shrimp and noodles tossed in a quick garlic butter sauce — simple and fast.
steps: Cook the noodles according to packet instructions and drain.
Melt the butter in a pan and fry the garlic for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes per side until pink and cooked through.
Stir in the soy sauce and lemon juice, then toss the noodles through.
Garnish with parsley and serve.
